what: POST /wp-json/wp/v2/users with the key (care account values as key-user-create), Wordfence active with application passwords on

body.message:
ERROR: The password provided is too weak. Please choose a stronger password and try again. A strong password will follow these guidelines:
  • At least 12 characters
  • Uppercase and lowercase letters
  • At least one symbol
  • At least one number
  • Avoid common words or sequences of letters/numbers
